case_number: 2024 INSC 1004; CIVIL APPEAL NO. ….. OF 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Civil) No.1904 of 2015)
summary: Court fee refund dispute; Maharashtra state law (MCFA, 1959) vs Central law (CFA, 1870); Section 89 CPC mediation settlements refund eligibility; notification requiring 50% refund challenged as invalid; State court fee acts override Central legislation; State of Maharashtra within legislative competence to issue notification; harmonious construction rejected; Salem Advocates precedent distinguished; ADR promotion rationale considered but legislative supremacy maintained; 100% refund claim dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Court Fees Act, 1959 s.43(1), s.49
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding 50% refund policy sustained; plea for 100% refund rejected.
